subtype: Approach: tempted by a gift or sweet [Pitfall]
passage:
Monday. Rekha Ma'am talked to Class Five about strangers. "A gift is never a reason to go anywhere with someone," she said. Zain doodled in his notebook.
Wednesday. After school a man at the lane offered him chocolate and a turn on a video game. "Just come and see something in the lane." Zain stared at the shiny wrapper and took a step. His friend Simran grabbed his sleeve. "Remember Monday? Come on!" They ran to the school gate.
Thursday. Zain told Rekha Ma'am, who wrote it all down and phoned his mother before lunch. He was still ashamed that he had nearly gone.

qa.q: Who grabbed Zain's sleeve in the lane?
qa.a: His friend Simran grabbed his sleeve.

qa.q: What was Zain feeling when he stared at the shiny wrapper?
qa.a: Tempted and eager for the treat, so his caution weakened and he took a step.

qa.q: What could Zain do next time he is offered a gift, and why?
qa.a: He could say no, step away and tell a trusted adult straight away, because a reward is not a reason to go anywhere.

qa.q: How does Simran see the offer in the lane?
qa.a: Simran recognises the situation Rekha Ma'am warned about and acts at once by pulling Zain away and running to the gate.

grounding: A boy tempted by a treat from a stranger takes a step, until his friend reminds him of the school safety talk.
